presets.name: Backcountry militia
presets.occasion: The look the game shipped with: linen shirt and stock, red waistcoat, caped hunting frock of green wool, buckskin breeches, wool leggings, buckled shoes and a cocked hat.
presets.note: The powder horn and shot pouch on crossed straps are the frontier set's horn_and_pouch; the legacy leather belt is not rebuilt yet.

presets.name: Townsman militia
presets.occasion: Turned out in his own clothes: brown frock coat, drab waistcoat, wool breeches, grey stockings, buckled shoes and a cocked hat.

presets.name: Massachusetts provincial, 1758
presets.occasion: Blue provincial coat faced red over a red double-breasted waistcoat, leather breeches, a checked shirt, blue leggings and the hat cut down round for the woods.

presets.name: Shirtsleeves, summer
presets.occasion: Working dress in camp or in the field: checked shirt, linen waistcoat and breeches, stockings, shoes and a knit cap.

presets.name: Winter militia
presets.occasion: Wool against the cold: grey frock coat over a brown wool waistcoat, black breeches, drab leggings, a black silk kerchief and a knit cap.
presets.note: The bible's winter militia wears a greatcoat and mittens; those are not built yet.
